notes: Leg opening is flat width, not circumference. Trouser length is outseam total length.
Letter code follows Hugo Boss conversion: 46=S, 48=M, 50=L, 52=XL, 54=2XL, 56=3XL. Write 2XL/3XL, never XXL/XXXL.
Manual measurement tolerance 1-2 cm on the chart. Custom orders use confirmed body measurements.
source_note: Shoulder and jacket length: Brooks Brothers garment table (Classic fit). Other circumferences: Zegna body measurements + standard suit ease, converted to garment reference values. Reference values, NOT sample-measured. Re-check against your own sample before listing/production.
